correctness.rationale: For p>=0,q>=0,p+q>=1 the undirected triangle/pentagon hub graph has n=1+2p+4q odd vertices with all degrees even. Over F2, the adjacency A has kernel exactly the all-ones line, so im A is the even-total-parity hyperplane; source local equations for triangle pair sums and pentagon (s,t) use an order-three base and show A^6=id on im A, equivalently A^7=A. Thus exactly 2^(n−1) states are periodic and the other 2^(n−1) enter at one step. Fixed-space dimensions for A^1,A^2,A^3,A^6 are d1=p+(p mod2),d2=2p,d3=p+2q+(p mod2)+2(q mod2),d6=2p+4q; Möbius inversion gives primitive-orbit counts Q1..Q6, all other periods zero, and exactly one transient predecessor per periodic state makes each orbit basin 2d. Independently built graph adjacency and enumerated all states for nine (p,q) cases up to n=13, including (1,1),(2,1),(0,2),(1,2), checking A^7=A and all fixed-point counts; no extension from finite enumeration is used as proof of all p,q.
